name: synthetic-document-failed
description: SYNTHETIC failed document job: the poll answers HTTP 200 {status: failed, error, billing: {charged_usd: 0}} — the job's own HTTP status (400 here) is NOT in the body, only its error code, which the lifecycle maps back. Zero usage (jobs-api handleGetDocumentJob, apiResumeWriter 'Not enough resume detail', 2026-10-29).

billing.note: Charged when the document is ready; failures are free.

error.message: Not enough resume detail to write a ready resume. Send resume_text (or an applicant with a resume), or use POST /v1/draft-resumes.
